name: Hologram
author: E. T. Carter
description: A scanline holographic projection thrown into a dark hazy room: a far measurement grid with blinking data blocks, a lattice of dialled rings with spinning arc gauges, and near scrolling readout bars, sliding against one another with slow parallax. Every edge splits into a pale core flanked by cyan and magenta ghosts, scanlines and a climbing roll bar comb through it, the brightness flickers and now and then a horizontal tear slips a slice sideways.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: Rate of the camera drift, gauge rotation, bar scrolling and interference bands; 0 freezes the projection.

params.label: Chroma split
params.effect: Horizontal offset of the cyan and magenta ghosts in CSS pixels; 0 is a clean single image.

params.label: Scanlines
params.effect: Depth of the horizontal scanlines combing the projection; 0 removes them.

params.label: Flicker
params.effect: Brightness flicker, dropouts and the frequency of horizontal tears; 0 is a steady projector.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: How much the projector lights the room: floor glow, drifting dust and motes in the beam.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer shifts the projection parallax; 0 ignores the mouse.
